We're launching a price monitoring service for the Beijing→Chengdu route on May 1st, 2026. I've already gotten the raw flight search results from the data team — they're saved under data/flights/raw/bj_cd_20260501_raw.json in the workspace.

I need two things done and saved as JSON files:

1. Create a monitoring task configuration file named task_003.json for this route. Use task ID '003', the standard default settings, and a start time of 2026-04-09T11:00:00+08:00.

2. We also have three days of historical price snapshots saved at data/flights/processed/price_snapshots_bj_cd.json. Using the task configuration you just created, evaluate each daily check and produce an alert_eval_003.json file that records — for each flight on each check day — whether an alert should have been triggered, and why (or why not). Make sure the anti-spam rules are respected.
